title: True and illusory freeing moves

D0.outcome: Explains that a freeing move (usually a pawn break) is real only if the position can bear the opening of lines.

D1.outcome: In a given structure, says which developing move must come before the break.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled positions, decides whether the break is real or illusory by comparing development and tempo.

D3.outcome: Predicts how a one-feature change in development flips a break from good to bad.

misconceptions: A freeing move is good in itself.
conditions: The comparison of development, tempo lead and structure supports the break.
contrasts: The ...e5 break while behind in tempi.
The same break after the pieces are developed.
